submissions.title: Palm Beach County commissioners put a halt on massive artificial intelligence data centers
submissions.excerpt: Commissioners voted unanimously Thursday to pursue a one-year moratorium on new hyperscale AI data centers, pending further study.
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Palm Beach County, FL commission voted unanimously on Aug 26 2026 (first reading only) for a one-year moratorium on new hyperscale AI data center construction, giving staff time to draft permanent regulations. Prompted by backlash over the commission's earlier rejection of 'Project Tango', a proposed expansion near the Arden community and Saddle View Elementary School (Project Tango is not in the current tracked-project list). A second, final vote is required and is tentatively scheduled for late September 2026 -- this is NOT yet enacted law. submissions.title: NVIDIA, OpenAI and SB Energy -- credit support on land, power, and shell for PORTS-Pike Technology Campus
submissions.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (Nvidia 8-K exhibit)
submissions.excerpt: Nvidia will guarantee up to $105 billion in residual value tied to an initial 4.25 gigawatts of IT capacity.
submissions.note: New project, not currently tracked (no Ohio project besides the already-tracked 'Stargate Lordstown' under Oracle). SB Energy will build and own the site; OpenAI is the 20-year tenant. IMPORTANT: the $105B figure is a residual-value financing GUARANTEE from Nvidia (credit support), not capex and not a cash investment -- Nvidia separately invests $1.5B directly in SB Energy. Do not record $105B as CAPEX_USD. Initial phase is 4.25 GW of IT capacity with an option for 3.75 GW more (8 GW total, i.e. IT load, not generation); first capacity phases expected 2028. SB Energy/SoftBank also state a separate $4.2B+ regional grid-infrastructure investment.
